top_signals.title: SpaceX Default Risk Hits Fresh Peak as Tech-Led Selloff Builds
top_signals.summary: The cost to protect SpaceX debt against default hit a record high Thursday, extending a move sparked by US election results that raised political risks for Elon Musk’s Texas-based companies. Shares in Musk’s SpaceX and Tesla Inc. tumbled amid a broad equity market selloff, led by a rout in chipmakers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Potential liquidity or banking-system instability affecting financial conditions.
